en.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio asserted Iran has lost complete control of the Strait of Hormuz and committed that the United States will prevent Tehran from closing this strategic waterway amid ongoing US-Iran tensions affecting maritime traffic and energy markets.

en.summary: US Vice President JD Vance stated in an exclusive Reuters interview that Iran must make substantial reductions in its uranium enrichment capabilities.

stories.title: Coalition intercepts Houthi ballistic missile north of Riyadh, tracks launch site in Sanaa

en.title: Coalition intercepts Houthi ballistic missile north of Riyadh, tracks launch site in Sanaa
en.summary: The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis north of Riyadh. The coalition stated it is tracking the missile's launch platform over Sanaa through its intelligence systems.

stories.title: Saudi air defenses knock down ballistic missile north of Riyadh

en.title: Saudi air defenses knock down ballistic missile north of Riyadh
en.summary: Saudi air defenses intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile north of Riyadh early Wednesday. The coalition spokesperson stated the launch platform in Yemen's capital would be tracked and destroyed.

en.title: Saudi Arabia Underscores Support for Legitimate Yemeni Govt to End Houthi Coup
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has reaffirmed its backing for Yemen's legitimate government and its stance against the Houthi movement's control.

en.title: Saudi FM Discusses Regional Developments with Egyptian, Jordanian Counterparts
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister held discussions with Egyptian and Jordanian officials regarding regional developments.

en.summary: The coalition reported destroying ballistic missiles launched by Houthis at Khamis Mushait and north of Riyadh.

stories.title: Egyptian, Jordanian FMs express solidarity with Saudi Arabia in call with Prince Faisal

en.title: Egyptian, Jordanian FMs express solidarity with Saudi Arabia in call with Prince Faisal
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan spoke by phone with the foreign ministers of Egypt and Jordan, who expressed support for Saudi Arabia against Houthi militia aggression. The ministers discussed strengthening bilateral relations and cooperation between the countries.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince Donates Blood, Launches Annual Donation Campaign for 2026

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince Donates Blood, Launches Annual Donation Campaign for 2026
en.summary: The Saudi Crown Prince participated in a blood donation and initiated an annual donation campaign for 2026 as a humanitarian initiative promoting social solidarity.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince, Syrian President Al-Sharaa discuss bolstering bilateral cooperation

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince, Syrian President Al-Sharaa discuss bolstering bilateral cooperation
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met with Syrian President Ahmad Al-Sharaa in Riyadh to review bilateral relations and explore cooperation opportunities across various fields and regional developments.

en.title: Saudia nears major aircraft order: source
en.summary: Saudia Group has progressed significantly on plans for a major aircraft order, completing an assessment of required aircraft. The group targets delivery between 2031 and 2040 and will determine ordering strategy once board approval is obtained.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Construction Index drops to 54.4 points in September

en.title: Saudi Construction Index drops to 54.4 points in September
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's construction index declined to 54.4 points in September from 55.4 points in August. The sector maintained expansion, continuing growth that began in May 2026.

en.title: TASI sees 4 negotiated deals worth SAR 49.1M
en.summary: The Saudi Exchange recorded four negotiated deals totaling SAR 49.1 million on October 7, involving stocks in SNB, KEC, Saudi RE, and other companies at agreed prices between buyers and sellers.

en.title: Value Capital previews Q3 2026 earnings
en.summary: Value Capital released earnings forecasts for the third quarter of 2026 covering 20 Saudi companies across various sectors, projecting mixed results with some banks expecting double-digit growth and some cement companies anticipating declines.

stories.title: ‎POS transactions hit SAR 16.5B last week: SAMA

en.title: POS transactions hit SAR 16.5B last week: SAMA
en.summary: Point-of-sale transactions in Saudi Arabia reached SAR 16.5 billion in the week ending October 3, rising significantly from SAR 13.4 billion the previous week, reflecting increased consumer spending through card payments.
